text:
sara: Heads up — launching the WeekOf email series for the benchmark webinar next Thu. Need final segment list + send windows so we can schedule in Console. Draft below. @alex @jia @tom_ops please confirm.

alex: Quick ask — can we stagger for APAC? propose 9am ET / 12pm ET / 3pm ET sends (3 sends per audience slice). :thumbsup:

jia: Segment draft (quick paste):
```
segment,criteria
trial_active_7d,trial_start<=7d
engaged_30d,last_open<=30d
cold_90d,last_engagement>90d
```
Are we gating by last_engagement < 90d for the main nurture?

tom_ops: Ops thumbs up on throttling — we can handle 5k/min. Will add fallback to `fallback-segment` on SES 5xx. @sendgrid-bot can you confirm daily quota and any scheduled maintenance windows?

marc: Creative ready. Subject A/B: 1) "Welcome to Redwood — Start faster" 2) "Your Redwood trial: get up & running". Preheader options: "Benchmarks & best practices inside" or "Webinar + quickstart checklist".

sara: Nice. @alex can you export the final segments and drop to marketing-sends S3 by EOD? I’ll update Console routes and pin schedule. Also include the RSVP survey link in the webinar hook.

alex: Uploading now -> s3://redwood-marketing/weekof-launch/segments.csv :rocket:

sendgrid-bot: Upload detected at s3://redwood-marketing/weekof-launch/segments.csv. Notifying ops and verifying file checksum.

tom_ops: I'll patch the send script to point at that S3 path. Concurrency plan: 200 connections, batch size 100. Rolling ramp flags: `--batch 100 --ramp 15m`. Will implement failover to `fallback-segment` if rate errors spike.

sara: One more — growth, confirm follow-up drip timing: 24h vs 72h for each segment? @alex @jia

alex: Recommend 24h for trial_active_7d, 72h for cold_90d. We can A/B later on engaged_30d.

jia: Agreed. I'll add eval metrics (opens, clicks, regen rate) and schedule a post-send debrief Fri 10am.

sara: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll post the final send plan in #marketing and pin it. :party-parrot:
